## 1.0.0 - November 7, 2026
- First release for Windows and Android.
- Main Zone, Zone 2, Sources, Sound, Speakers, System, Explorer, Hidden and Log tabs.
- 20 undocumented RX-V677 settings (speaker levels/distances, input trims, display dimmer, max/power-on volume, HDMI CEC, ECO...) with read-back verification.
- Hidden-command scanner, backup/restore with diff, snapshot export, traffic log, auto-update.
